not_shown_and_why.c_arm: No C-arm frame with a human-read transitional vertebra exists in the corpus. C-ArmLSpine case42, case121, case136 are SPINEPS+VERIDAH L2-L6 against TotalSegmentator L1-L5 on a lumbar-only cone-beam CT with no rib to count from (SchwingNet/results/COUPLING.md, 'The three real L6 patients'; each frame shows five bodies above the sacrum); the COBRA calls are the same model on a registered planning CT (SchwingNet/results/cobra_lstv_screen.md). VERIDAH's L6 call has a PPV near 42 % against the CTSpinoPelvic1K release labels (transitional_subtypes.md). The gallery's C-arm cell (case136) is therefore not carried into Figure 1.

c_arm_cobra_two_labeller.what: Since the 05:46 build the COBRA2026 registry arm (built 06:49) holds L6 persons on the two-labeller tier (SPINEPS+VERIDAH and a TotalSegmentator rib count agree) whose kV projections are real. Not shown: no person has read them (the arm has no 'read' row), T1 is outside every one of their fields, both sit on the G3 test side as unverified automatic calls (stratify.json), and every other truth on this figure is human (two-reader consensus, the VerSe published read, the BUU-LSPINE dataset report). A real-frame cell for them would be the figure's only automatic truth; if a reader confirms one, its frame can fill a C-arm cell.

not_shown_and_why.buu_permission: BUU-LSPINE states no licence; its site asks for acknowledgement and forbids re-identification (SchwingNet/results/gallery/GALLERY_CHECK.md, 'Still owed' 2). Reproducing the two films is a permission question for the PI; if refused, replace film=dict(key=...) by film=dict(empty=...) in COLUMNS (a) and (d) and rebuild.
not_shown_and_why.totalsegmentator_l6: TS cases ['s0224', 's0790', 's1124', 's1171', 's1304', 's1350', 's1380'] (and s1178) read normal on verification (ts12_subtype_override.json); the script refuses any TotalSegmentator case.
not_shown_and_why.lumbar_rib_and_castellvi_I_II: Not included: the contrast would need a fifth component or a column whose cells mean different things in different rows; the four components are the four phenotypes.
not_shown_and_why.b_film_c_film: No released radiograph set carries a T13 label or a Castellvi grade (BUU-LSPINE's L4L6 sheet records counts only; CSXA and NHANES carry no grade).

choices.b: verse547 (2026-09-24). The first build used verse588 for its long bilateral thirteenth rib pair, but the transitional registry built after it (results/transitional_registry/verse/rows.csv) flags verse588 REVIEW: labeller A (SPINEPS+VERIDAH) counts 12 thoracic from C1 against the published read, and labeller B cannot reach T1, so its thoracic count rests on the read and the mask alone. Of the six VerSe T13 spines, verse547 and verse631 are the two where the read, the raw mask id 28, labeller A (13 thoracic from C2) and labeller B (13 rib-bearing bodies from T1, rib contact) all agree; verse631 also carries a lumbosacral Castellvi read (a second anomaly), and its slab and render (grid job 40429436, /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/figure1/v2_t13) show the thirteenth ribs less clearly than verse547's. verse602 (A agrees, B cannot reach T1) was rendered in the same job; its thirteenth ribs read as short bars on the slab. verse547's slab shows the published read's picture: a long, downward-running rib on the observer's left and a short one (a stump; 35 mm on the Moller rib mask) on the observer's right. verse547 sits on the G3 test side (stratify.json); it is shown here, not scored.
choices.c: 0021 over 0008: 0008 carries a second anomaly (lumbar_rib=True, 'b/l rudimentary ribs at T12 or hypoplastic ribs') and its render has bowel contrast over the left transverse process; 0021's render is clean. A coronal slab through the transverse processes was rendered for both (offsets 0-26 mm behind the body centroid, 0 and 8 mm slabs) and showed no plane where the joint with the ala reads unambiguously, so the label surface is kept.
choices.arrows_lateral: 2026-09-24 rebuild: the CT and render arrows of (a) and (d) are placed from the mid-sagittal slice's own labels (lateral_tip; the build refuses a tip whose pixels behind it are not the target). The earlier rule (2 px in front of the projected box's anterior edge at its vertical centre) put (d)'s tip on L4 (release id 23): the projected upper 30 mm of the sacrum label starts 12 mm above the label's mid-sagittal top, so its centre fell at L4's anterior-inferior corner. (a)'s tip moved from the L6 body's anterior-superior corner, 5 mm in front of it, to the middle of its anterior wall. Film arrows are unchanged (corner-row boxes).
